# Cobalt Intelligence

> Cobalt Intelligence provides business entity data sourced live from US Secretary of State offices and other authoritative registries. Common uses: KYB (know-your-business), lender underwriting, fraud detection, sales prospecting, and registered-agent lookup. Data is normalized across 50+ jurisdictions and served via REST API, a TypeScript SDK, and a CLI.

## Endpoints

- API base: `https://apigateway.cobaltintelligence.com/`
- Dashboard / API keys: `https://app.cobaltintelligence.com/dashboard/quickStart`
- Sign up (free trial, no card): `https://app.cobaltintelligence.com/create-account`
- Documentation: `https://documentation.cobaltintelligence.com`
- Support: `support@cobaltintelligence.com`

## CLI for AI agents

Install:

```bash
npm install -g @cobaltintelligence/cli
# or
npx @cobaltintelligence/cli --help
```

Authenticate:

```bash
cobalt auth setup            # guided, opens browser
# or
export COBALT_API_KEY="..."  # CI / agent-friendly
```

Programmatic onboarding hints (for agents that need to ask a human for a key):

```bash
cobalt auth urls --format json
```

This returns `signup_url`, `key_url`, `docs_url`, and a `human_action` string the agent can read verbatim.

## Core capabilities

- `cobalt sos search --name <name> --state <2-letter>` — Secretary of State business search
- `cobalt sos get --id <id> --state <state>` — full filing record
- `cobalt sos retry <retryId>` — recover a long-running search by retryId
- `cobalt sos pending` — list retryIds the CLI has saved on disk
- `cobalt ofac screen --name <name>` — OFAC sanctions screen
- `cobalt tin verify --tin <tin> --name <legal-name>` — TIN matching
- `cobalt full-verification start|status|wait` — 50-state verification

## Output contract

Every command emits a stable JSON envelope:

```json
{ "data": { ... }, "meta": { ... }, "error": null }
```

On failure, `error` is `{ code, message, details, retry_after_seconds? }`. Stable error codes:

- `NO_API_KEY` (exit 4) — missing credential; `error.details.onboarding` contains the human-action steps
- `UNAUTHORIZED` (exit 4) — credential rejected; `error.details.onboarding` contains the recovery steps
- `RATE_LIMITED` (exit 3) — includes `retry_after_seconds`
- `TIMEOUT` (exit 6) — includes `retryId` if one was issued
- `BAD_REQUEST` (exit 5), `NOT_FOUND` (exit 2), `SERVER_ERROR` (exit 8), `NETWORK_ERROR` (exit 7)

## Billing & retryId safety

Every SOS search consumes a credit even if the API falls back to a `retryId`. The CLI auto-persists every retryId to `~/.config/cobalt-cli-nodejs/pending/<retryId>.json` *before* polling begins, so a crash, timeout, or Ctrl+C never loses a paid-for result. Use `cobalt sos retry <retryId>` to recover.

## MCP server

`@cobaltintelligence/mcp-server` (coming soon) — wraps the same endpoints as MCP tools for direct use inside Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, and other MCP-aware clients.
